meta.title: Publish the event to the invited vendor: draft_trade_request_uuids[0] is omitted

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and an RFQ (pricing) round attached, not published.
steps: The buyer publishes the event, exactly as the journey does, with the draft trade request uuids left out of the body.
As the buyer, read the event and check that the event is still a draft (not published).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the event is still a draft (not published).

plan.title: Publish the event to the invited vendor: draft_trade_request_uuids[0] is omitted

act.say: The buyer publishes the event, exactly as the journey does, with the draft trade request uuids left out of the body.

assert.say: the event is still a draft (not published)
